name: Surf Side Deli
notes: The restaurant's own site (surfsidedelisd.com) lists full item names/descriptions for its Sandwiches under '#1 USS Nimitz' etc. but prices NOTHING on-page — it only links out to Clover ordering (clover.com/online-ordering/surf-side-deli-san-diego-2), which is a client-rendered React SPA (COLO2) with no server-rendered prices and no WordPress moo-clover REST endpoint on the domain (checked /wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories, 404) — genuinely needs a browser. A second ordering domain (ordersurfsidedelisd.com) is the same dead end (only $0.00 cart placeholders in its static HTML). Used the DoorDash marketplace listing instead (schema.org Menu JSON-LD, server-side) — address confirmed as 1912 Rosecrans Street, matching the work list exactly. Markup check across all 74 raw items: no consistent divisor across 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30 (POS-style odd-cent pricing, passes). Cross-checked the Sandwiches section's item names against the restaurant's own site: #1 USS Nimitz, #2 USS Midway, #3 Rockslides, #4 South Side, #5 Indicator and #6 The Admiral's Avocado Delight all matched by name, confirming this is the right menu and it's not stale. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' section (duplicate highlight reel of items already listed under their real categories) and 'Merchandise' (hats/t-shirts, adjunct, not food). Categories reached: Sandwiches (25, including a sandwich platter, kids sandwiches, custom/half-sandwich options), Surf Side Salads, Drinks, Sides, Sweets, Chips, Sliced Meats and Cheese (by-the-pound deli counter), Ice, Combo, Catering. This looks like the complete real menu for a sandwich deli — no obvious core section (e.g. hot entrees, breakfast) is referenced anywhere else that's missing here.

name: Cotijas Taco Shop
notes: The work-list website (cotijastierrasanta.com) is unreachable — TLS handshake fails outright and the plain-HTTP fallback returns Cloudflare error 1001 (DNS resolution failure reaching the origin behind Cloudflare), so the domain's hosting looks broken rather than just JS-gated. Found the restaurant's own Toast ordering page instead (confirmed by exact address match in search: 10645 Tierrasanta Blvd Suite J), and this Toast deployment DID embed the full catalog directly in window.__OO_STATE__ (extracted by brace-balancing from the opening '{', 144KB) — unlike a same-batch Toast page for a different restaurant that only returned dining-option metadata. 229 priced dishes across 24 groups: Breakfast Plates, Breakfast Burritos, Burritos, Quesadillas, Enchiladas, Mini Tacos, Soft Tacos, Hard Tacos, Tortas, Combination Plates, Sea Food Plates, Mariscos, Special Plates, Baja Bowl, Flour Shell Bowl, Tostadas, Ensalada, Fries and Chips, Caldos, Kids Meals, A La Carte, Sides, Desserts, Drinks — this is a taco shop with real Soft/Hard/Mini Taco sections present (unlike a sibling restaurant in this batch whose only reachable source turned out to have no plain Tacos section at all). Markup check across all 229 items: no consistent divisor across 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.17/1.20/1.25/1.30 (highest hit rate 30/229 = 13%, consistent with ordinary POS odd-cent pricing, not a uniform surcharge) — this is the restaurant's own first-party ordering platform, so no markup was expected. Verified a sample dish name and price appear literally in the raw HTML bytes.
